pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or scaling into losing positions within a 1.00 ATR window; pyramiding is exclusively permitted after the primary trade achieves a +$10.00 unrealized profit buffer and breaks even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a confirmed 3-period volume spike and an order-flow imbalance ratio > 1.6 in the direction of the trade on the M1 timeframe before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing micro-harvest locks at +$12.00 profit and enforce hard profit scaling targets starting at +$15.00 up to +$30.00.
